subject.title: feat: sign stored OpenClaw catalog publications

question: May the public plugins-feed endpoint become DSSE-only and unavailable until a signing secret is configured, or must existing unsigned-feed consumers retain a supported transition path?
rationale: This is a public protocol and availability decision: a mechanical patch cannot determine whether existing clients may be broken while the separate OpenClaw consumer and deployment configuration are still rolling out.

options.title: Stage DSSE alongside the legacy feed
options.body: Preserve the existing unsigned representation through negotiation or a versioned route, add compatibility coverage, and switch clients only after key provisioning and OpenClaw consumption are live.

options.title: Approve a coordinated breaking rollout
options.body: Explicitly accept the DSSE-only and fail-closed endpoint after documenting deployment order, rollback ownership, affected consumers, and operational proof.

recommendation.title: Stage DSSE alongside the legacy feed
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing unsigned representation through negotiation or a versioned route, add compatibility coverage, and switch clients only after key provisioning and OpenClaw consumption are live.

likelyOwner.reason: His review comments already cover the signer rotation and HTTP cache contract that the remaining compatibility decision extends.
